learning_outcomes.text: has theoretical knowledge about phenomena in materials used in modern electrical engineering designs and the properties of these materials
is able to combine knowledge about the structure and technologies of materials with their application in modern electrical engineering designs
is able to acquire information from literature, databases, and other sources; is able to integrate acquired information, interpret it, draw conclusions, and formulate and justify opinions
is aware of the responsibility for their own work and readiness to abide by teamwork principles and take responsibility for jointly completed tasks

syllabus_topics: Transformer oil testing (4 hours)
Testing of hydrophobic properties of polymer covers for power cables (4 hours)
Technological process of ceramic insulator production - ZPE Boguchwała (2 hours)
Technology of manufacturing composite insulators - ZPE Boguchwała (2 hours)
Technological process of drying, degassing, saturation and impregnation of paper-oil insulation for power cables - Telefonika - Kable S.A. (2 hours)
Technology of manufacturing power cables with XLPE cross-linked polyethylene insulation - Telefonika - Kable S.A. (2 hours)
Technology of manufacturing power cables with polyvinyl chloride insulation and sheath - Telefonika - Kable S.A. (2 hours)
Technology of manufacturing bare and insulated power conductors - Telefonika - Kable S.A. (2 hours)
Introduction, classification, and application ranges of technological processes (1 hour)
Conducting elements – properties, technology fundamentals (2 hours)
Physical fundamentals of technological processes of insulation systems (2 hours)
Technological processes of paper-oil insulation systems (2 hours)
Synthetic polymers in the construction of electrical devices (2 hours)
Basic physicochemical properties of synthetic polymers for technological purposes (2 hours)
Classification of polymer technological processes in electrical devices (2 hours)
Fundamentals of polymer technology in electrical devices (2 hours)
Fundamentals of inorganic material technology in electrical devices (2 hours)
Applications of inorganic material technology in the construction of electrical devices (2 hours)
Magnetic elements in the construction of electrical devices (2 hours)
Fundamentals of soft magnetic material technology (2 hours)
Technological processes of permanent magnets (2 hours)
Special technologies and issues (2 hours)
Development trends in electrical device technologies (1 hour)
assessment_rules: Lectures are assessed by a test. Laboratory classes are assessed by a test and oral answer. Passing the module requires passing all laboratory classes.
